title: Date libraries: when, which, and where Temporal stands
objectives: Recall which jobs `Date` + `Intl` already cover, and which justify a library: wall-clock arithmetic in a named zone, durations, many input formats
Recall how date-fns v4 (plain functions on `Date`, in the machine's zone unless you pass `in: tz(…)`) differs from Luxon (an immutable `DateTime` that carries its zone)
Recall Temporal's types (`Instant`, `ZonedDateTime`, `PlainDate`) and its status in October 2026: Stage 4, shipped in Chrome/Edge 144, Firefox 139 and Node 26, not yet in Safari
Recall why Moment.js is not for new code: a legacy project in maintenance mode, with a mutable API
